feed.text: Jones closed with eight points (2-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 4-5 FT), two rebounds, one assist and two steals over 27 minutes during Thursday's 124-112 loss to the Spurs.

feed.text: Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

feed.text: Leonard (knee) could return in the next few weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

feed.title: Jordan Goodwin
feed.text: Goodwin closed Wednesday's 128-107 win over the Kings with two points (1-2 FG), five rebounds, three assists and one steal in 17 minutes.
